issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to create a constructor that follows the attribute order from the UML diagram, but the UML order (numberOfInscribedStudents, lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfTutors) conflicts with the prose attribute listing and with the solution's constructor parameter order. The solution's constructor uses (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). This discrepancy will confuse students about the expected constructor signature and may cause tests or reference implementations to disagree on parameter order.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected constructor parameter order explicit and consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement (both prose and UML) to specify the constructor signature used in the solution (lectureName first), or (B) change the solution constructor to match the UML order (numberOfInscribedStudents, lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfTutors) and update the template comments/examples accordingly. Ensure tests (if any) expect the same parameter order.
